title: Securing Singapore’s Critical Information Infrastructure Dependent on Satellite and Space Systems
what_it_is: Securing Singapore’s Critical Information Infrastructure Dependent on Satellite and Space Systems

sections.label: Satellite use and cybersecurity
sections.summary: Some Singapore enterprises use satellites as a secondary channel, so disruption impact is limited, and the Government will work with industry on space infrastructure security.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: In Singapore, specific enterprises may use satellites as a secondary channel for communications or environmental monitoring.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The impact of potential disruptions to satellite services today is therefore limited.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: As cybersecurity threats to space systems are expected to evolve, the Government will work closely with the industry to enhance the security and resilience of Singapore’s space infrastructure.

sections.label: Internet traffic and submarine cables
sections.summary: Over 99% of Singapore's Internet traffic uses non-satellite means, and Singapore is a hub for submarine cables.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: More than 99% of our Internet traffic is via non-satellite means.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Unlike other, perhaps, larger countries, Singapore is a hub for submarine cables.

sections.label: Nationwide standalone 5G rollout
sections.summary: About five years ago Singapore rolled out the 5G standalone network, likely one of the first countries with nationwide standalone 5G coverage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: About five years ago, we rolled out the 5G standalone network, making us probably one of the first countries in the world to have nation-wide coverage of standalone 5G mobile coverage.

sections.label: International space cybersecurity standards
sections.summary: Singapore participates in international bodies setting space industry resilience and cybersecurity standards, and satellite operators adopt standards for their use cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: On top of that, we participate actively in international bodies that set standards for resilience and cybersecurity for the space industry, for example, international standards, such as those from the International Organization for Standardization, Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, and the Consultative Committee for Space Data Systems.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Satellite operators and their partners adopt cybersecurity and resilience standards relevant to their specific use cases, such as for information technology, aerospace and telecommunications.
